_comment: The API definitions the suite generates every target from, vendored from
voxgig/apidef-validate. Do not edit them here: change the upstream
definition, then run `npm run vendor-defs` (tools/vendor-defs.cjs). Each
entry in `apis` resolves to the highest-versioned OpenAPI or Swagger file
named for it in the upstream def/ folder at `ref`, and the rest of this
file records what that run fetched. The suite checks every file against
its sha256, so a hand edit fails the build.
